title: Flood control - 40 plausible matches, five allowed out
provenance: The load-reduction principle (strategy brief Part two, driven by Jen's burnout warning 3 Jun 2026): 'an agent that surfaces more opportunities could ADD to the firefighting'. This case makes the discipline mechanical.

org.name: Member C archetype (large London children's arts charity)

expected.judge_guidance: The filler pool for this case is deliberately large (40+ rows) and deliberately good - an established £1m+ London children's arts charity is eligible for most of the catalogue's strongest segment. The test is what the agent does with abundance. A 5 picks at most five, each with a distinct goal-shaped reason (not five interchangeable arts grants), states how it chose ('38 plausible; prioritised by deadline window, amount fit against the £500k gap, and multi-year potential'), and parks the rest accessibly rather than listing them. The selection_summary flag is that accounting - silent truncation fails (the user must know the longlist exists without being handed it). Listing 10+ items, or 5 items with generic whys, is the canonical R7 failure regardless of their individual quality.

notes: The pool file is the build-time artefact that makes this case work: it must be genuinely strong, not strawman filler, or the case proves nothing. Build it from real catalogue rows for London children/creative at fixture-snapshot time.
